about_the_game:
No Path Forward is a first-person psychological-horror game set in a small mountain village.

The anxieties of life have been weighing you down. You decide to listen to your coworker's advice and take a solo, overnight hiking trip through a part of the mountains you haven't been to before. What could go wrong? Surely your mind will slow down once you're exposed to beautiful mother nature.

Get To The Trailer Home

All you know is that you need to find a trailer home to stay in for the night. Not just any trailer home, but the one your coworker's uncle owns. The trailer home that you have no pictures or details of. As long as you were on pace during your hike, you should arrive before the sun sets.

Figure Out What's Off

As you make your way, something feels wrong about this place. You can't put your finger on it, but something is not right. Uncover the truth by thinking it through, talking with locals, and exploring the area.

Take a Break

Finally.. Take a rest for the night in the comfort of the trailer -- a place for you to recharge, recoup, and destress before your next big day of hiking.

Make It Out

All you really want to do is get THROUGH the night, so that you can continue on with your hike in the morning. You just have a few hours of the trail before you get to the parking lot where your coworker should be waiting for you.

content_descriptors.notes: Fearful situations, psychological horror, use of alcohol

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX10 capability
  • DirectX: Version 10

short_description: Stressed out from life, you decide to take an impromptu weekend hike through the mountains. As you go on your way, it seems like the stresses of life followed you into the woods. Once you get to the trailer home for the night, you should feel a bit better.
